Asset Type: Compressor & Pump - Rotary, Liquid Ring

Boundary:

* Pump or compressor

* Speed reducer
* Control components except for relays
* Miscellaneous components, e.g. filters, traps, strainers, orifices, and check valves
* Coupling
* Relays
* Safety Relief Valves

Excluded from the boundary:

* Electrical and electronic components
* Further details and information on appropriate PM tasks for these components may be found in the database under the specific component type name, e.g. I&C - Pressure Switches.

Note: I have used the term "Boundary" to refer to the list of components that are included in the asset, and "Excluded from the boundary" to refer to the components that are not included in the asset but are mentioned in the long description.
